workflows.name: Daily todo digest
workflows.description: 08:00 IST daily: open todos + pending reminders to Discord.

workflows.name: Morning briefing
workflows.description: Scheduled demo: summarizer agent -> conditional Discord post.

steps.prompt: Today is {{date}}. Draft a 5-line morning briefing template: date, top 3 focus slots, one reminder to check Harness tasks. Keep it generic until wired to real sources.

workflows.name: On-demand review
workflows.description: Triggered from Discord with !review <text>. Runs coder agent, posts result, conditionally pings.

steps.prompt:
Review the following request/code and give findings + minimal suggestion:

{{trigger.text}}

then.message: ⚠️ The review mentions *urgent* — please take a look.

workflows.name: Ping test
workflows.description: Manual smoke test: node src/index.js --run ping-test

workflows.name: Daily inbox → TODOs
workflows.description: Reference flow: agent sweep writes JSON, quiet-condition stops on nothing-new, task step files TODOs, notify posts the count.

steps.prompt: Sweep recent chats and email for actionable asks. Respond with ONLY valid JSON, no other text: { "created": <int>, "skippedExisting": <int>, "tasks": [{"title": <string>}] }.

else.message: Inbox sweep: {{steps.sweep.created}} new TODO(s), {{steps.sweep.skippedExisting}} already filed.

workflows.name: India pre-market briefing
workflows.description: 08:45 IST weekdays = 30 min before NSE 09:15 open. Quotes + news + Reddit -> finance-india agent -> #finance.

workflows.name: US pre-market briefing
workflows.description: 18:30 IST weekdays = 60 min before US 19:00 IST open. Quotes + news + Reddit -> finance-us agent -> #finance.

workflows.name: On-demand finance briefing
workflows.description: Discord: !finance india|us. Runs the briefing immediately.

workflows.name: Scout research test
workflows.description: Manual test: scout researches a topic, summarizer compresses, posts to Discord.

steps.prompt:
Research this topic with web_search + web_fetch and return an evidence pack:

{{trigger.text}}

Compress this evidence pack into a Discord briefing (TL;DR + key points + next action):

{{steps.research}}

workflows.name: Deep research pipeline
workflows.description: Scout -> analyst -> critic gate -> writer publish. Discord: !research <topic>.

steps.prompt:
Research this topic with web_search (2+ queries) + web_fetch (2+ pages). Return evidence pack:

{{trigger.text}}

Analyze this evidence pack. Verdict + findings with sources + risks + recommendation:

{{steps.gather}}

Red-team this analysis. SHIP or REWORK + holes + top fix:

{{steps.analyze}}

then.prompt:
Turn this analysis into a Discord post (headline + 3-5 bullets + CTA):

{{steps.analyze}}

else.message:
🛑 Critic says REWORK ({{steps.redteam.holes}} holes). Top fix: review needed.

Analysis held for human review — check dashboard Runs for details.

workflows.name: Ship review pipeline
workflows.description: Coder drafts, critic gates SHIP/REWORK, assistant summarizes. Discord: !ship <diff-or-idea>.

steps.prompt:
Review this and propose findings + minimal diff:

{{trigger.text}}

Red-team this draft. SHIP or REWORK + holes + top fix:

{{steps.draft}}

then.prompt:
Summarize this SHIP-approved draft for Discord (short, punchy):

{{steps.draft}}

else.message: 🛑 REWORK needed ({{steps.gate.holes}} holes). Draft held — check dashboard Runs.
